signature: A sunflower field taller than you under a turning day and a starry night: two grandmothers' camp cottage full of honey bottles, a buzzing beehive, a weird flower that hums like a machine, and a blue flower whose petal turns to dust and blooms a path south to the endless wheat
no_exit_reason: The page is an epistolary testimony with no Entrances or Exits section and names no way out; its link list (Level 139, Level 141) is navigation only. The wheat field the flower path leads to is terrain, not a level transition. No exit is invented. The level is reached from Level 19 (perimeter blur) and Level 149 (Barrier noclip); those arrivals exist.
entity_policy: NO ENTITY PER SOURCE. Bees (testimony, animals) appear as particle swarms and buzzing at the hive, the sunflowers and the weird flower. The distant giggling voice is heard once every 6-10 minutes with a caption and never shown. The human-made buzz of the weird flower is only a sound; no watcher is shown. Mary and Gina/Georgia are never shown: they exist through their letters and notes.
notes: SOURCE (all TESTIMONY, epistolary page): a field stretching to the horizon; normal day-night cycle, sunsets around 6 pm and sunrises around 5 am (the narrators' convention), stars at night; a distant voice giggles; a lobby with many honey bottles; a backyard with flowers and a little one that looks sad and tired; many sunflowers; buzzing and wind; a beehive near the first sunflower field; cultivated honey, sunflower honey tasting faintly of sunflower oil; the last comb jarred and named after the queen; a second field of weeds left of the sunflower field with a tiny tree in front of a weird hydrangea-like flower giving a human-made buzz, visited by bees; a peculiar blue flower whose petal turns into sparkly dust, after which flowers bloom where the dust flew into a path south toward an infinite wheat field, where it stops abruptly; chilly mornings and a jacket in the closet; the couple set camp first and were asked to investigate the level. ADAPTATION: the camp cottage (ground-floor lobby with shelves of bottles, strainer table, kitchen corner, closet; sleeping loft at +2.75 m up a stair; porch), the fenced backyard, a four-box hive row, the 96 x 74 m sunflower field with walkable furrows, the weed field to its north, the wheat from 150 m south (planted band, then a waist-high golden surface to the horizon); rolling grass to the horizon in a far mesh; a soft limit 250 m from the camp (the field slows you and holds you). Time runs at 1 hour per 75 s (sunrise 5:00, sunset 18:00, stars at night); in QA mode the clock is frozen and stills set their own hour. The petal path blooms over 50 s ('a few hours later' compressed). The author's closing comment ('sunflower hill', 'grannies') is not used as lore. Terrain uses CC0 Poly Haven sparse_grass, dirt_floor and old_wood_floor textures already in assets/external.
